subject: Request: SOC 2 assurance addendum to cover post-report period (InteropPlus)
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice.chen@interopplus.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: security@interopplus.com
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 addendum / post-report coverage request

Hi Sofia,

Hope youre well. We're in the final stages of our vendor review for Q2 renewals and need a short written assurance that Redwoods most recent SOC 2 Type II report (period ended 2026-12-31) covers operations through today, or — if not — a formal addendum/statement that details the extent of coverage for the period between the report end date and now. Specifically InteropPlus InfoSec needs:

- A short, signed addendum (PDF) stating whether the controls in the report remain in effect from 2027-01-01 to present, and whether any material control changes or exceptions occurred.
- Any interim compensating controls or monitoring performed if there were gaps.
- A point of contact for follow-up evidence requests (e.g., logs, configuration snapshots).

Can you confirm whether you can provide that and an estimated turnaround? For context, attached is our standard SOC evidence checklist — it's mostly for reference.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Senior Security Analyst
InteropPlus

Attachment: interopplus_evidence_checklist.pdf
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@interopplus.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 07 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 addendum / post-report coverage request

Alice thanks for the note. We can provide a signed assurance addendum that confirms the state of controls for the post-report period and calls out any material changes.

Looping in Marcus from Security and Lauren from Legal to draft and review the statement. Marcus/Lauren: can you please review InteropPlus checklist (attached) and prep a short addendum (1 page preferred) that:

- Confirms whether controls described in the 2026-12-31 SOC 2 Type II report have remained in place through 2027-05-08, or
- If not, summarizes any exceptions and compensating controls.

We typically deliver a signed PDF within 48 hours for routine requests like this. Alice: would a 48-hour turnaround meet your deadline?

Sofia Ivanova
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com

Subject: Draft language for InteropPlus assurance addendum (please review)

Marcus / Lauren,

Draft below is an initial version I plan to send to InteropPlus. Please flag anything LEGAL/security needs to soften/expand. We want this to be explicit enough for their vendor team but not over-commit.

--- DRAFT START ---
Redwood Inference Assurance Addendum (post-report period)
Reference: SOC 2 Type II report for period ending 2026-12-31

To whom it may concern,

This Assurance Addendum is provided by Redwood Inference in connection with the SOC 2 Type II report dated for the audit period ending December 31, 2026. As of May 8, 2027, Redwood Inference confirms that the control environment described in the referenced report has remained in place and operational, except for the limited system change described below. The change and compensating measures are summarized as follows:

- Control change: Replacement of third-party log ingestion agent on 2027-02-15 for improved stability.
- Impact: No material control deviation; agent replacement was validated by the security team and monitoring showed uninterrupted log collection.
- Compensating controls: Additional validation runs and extended retention of raw ingestion snapshots during the maintenance window.

This addendum is a limited attestation and does not supersede the full SOC 2 Type II report. If you require specific artifacts (logs, validation reports), please let us know and we will coordinate secure transfer.

Sincerely,

Sofia Ivanova
Head of Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
--- DRAFT END ---

Attachments: redwood_assurance_addendum_v1.docx

Expect to review and return comments in the morning; Ill incorporate and send to InteropPlus once we have legal signoff.
